---
title: "check-base-r-tabs.yml"
---

Diff-scoped check that fails when a pull request adds or edits a `panel-tabset`
that has an "R (tidymodels)" tab and no base R tab.
The lab's rule is to write a lab's R code with tidymodels,
or to show tidymodels and base R side by side.
A textbook lab such as ISL's writes its R code in base R,
so a lab that adapts one keeps the book's base R code
beside the tidymodels version
(Ezra, 2026-11-17, Morrison-Lab/lds#2708).

A base R tab is a tab heading that reads exactly
"R", "Base R", "R (base)", or "R (base R)".
Headings in code fences, and headings below the tab level, are not tabs.
A tabset whose R code has no base R counterpart opts out with
`<!-- base-r-tab: none: reason -->` inside the tabset; the reason is required.

A tabset is checked only when the pull request adds a line inside it,
so an untouched tabset is never reflagged.
With no base ref the check skips instead of scanning the whole tree;
`whole-tree` measures a corpus.

## Usage

Copy
[`examples/check-base-r-tabs.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-base-r-tabs.yml)
to `.github/workflows/` in your repository.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check |
| `fail` | `true` | Fail the workflow on a finding instead of warning |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Scan every tabset, not only those a PR touches |
| `runs-on` | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label; self-hosted only for a private repository |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version to set up |
